before.exam_tip_html: For “Describe a Study” questions on Damasio et al., structure your answer around aim, procedure, results and conclusion in that order — examiners reward this clear structure specifically. For “Assess” or “Evaluate” items on this study, always pair a strength with a weakness and develop each with a reason (for example, “this is a weakness because…”), then finish with a supported judgement rather than just listing points.
